expectations.text: States the January 2025 AI Diffusion IFR was never formally rescinded in the Federal Register
expectations.evidence: Admits ignorance of disposition: "get current... confirmation of its status — including whether it has been rescinded, replaced, or is in effect"; never states it was not rescinded

expectations.text: Notes BIS announced non-enforcement/intent to rescind in May 2025
expectations.evidence: No mention of the May 2025 non-enforcement announcement; only "effective date was pushed out at least once" and "public discussion of it being replaced"

expectations.text: Cites GAO decision B-337935: the non-enforcement announcement is itself a CRA 'rule' that was not submitted to Congress
expectations.evidence: No mention of GAO B-337935 or the CRA finding

expectations.text: States the operative successor approach: country-specific rules (e.g., the July 2026 UAE advanced-chip rule, 91 FR 43034) rather than a global framework
expectations.evidence: No mention of the country-specific successor approach or the July 2026 UAE rule 91 FR 43034

expectations.text: Advises: do not structure around a 'replacement diffusion framework' that does not exist; apply current ECCN 3A090/4A090-family controls, license policies, and end-user rules, and monitor BIS
expectations.evidence: "Classify your specific chip/accelerator SKUs against the current 3A090 performance thresholds (and check 4A090...)"; builds around durable China/D:5/Entity List controls and re-checking status rather than the diffusion overlay
